newsitem.title: GREECE: Drachma up vs ecu, forward curve flat.
newsitem.headline: Drachma up vs ecu, forward curve flat.

text.p: The ecu continued to slide against the drachma trading around 310.65/70 in late dealings, depos were steady and implied drachma rates from forex forwards were flat at 9.60 percent from tomnext to one-year tenors, dealers said.
Fixed coupon bonds and two-year zeros gained ground, up six ticks in terms of price since early dealings.

"Ecu/drachma has broken the 311 level on the downside on sales of ecus for drachmas from abroad," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "Ecu/drachma might fluctuate for a while at levels above 310 but the trend is clearly pointing downwards."
Ecu/drachma kicked off the day at 311.10/15 but fell steadily throughout the day to hover around 310.65/70 in late trade, dealers said.
Bond dealers said fixed coupon bonds and two-year zeros were firmer but FRNs were holding in lacklustre late trade.
"Fixed coupon bonds and zeros are up six ticks in terms of price," said a bond dealer at a foreign bank.
The mark was quoted at 159.00/10 from Tuesday's 159.035 fix, the dollar at 269.81/91 drachmas from 269.600 and the ecu at 310.66/76 from 310.720 drachmas.
